description: Tray-resident Windows tool that edits the focused input field of any app in an embedded Neovim
notes: Run 'anvi' once; it stays in the tray. Ctrl+Alt+E edits the focused input field.
Enable the tray menu's startup item to launch anvi at sign-in.
Neovim and the Moralerspace Argon HW font are bundled; nothing else needs to be installed.
Local config lives outside the Scoop app directory and survives updates:
Config lives where Neovim puts it: %XDG_CONFIG_HOME%\anvi\init.lua, or %LOCALAPPDATA%\anvi\init.lua when XDG_CONFIG_HOME is unset.
The startup log names the exact directory it looked in: %LOCALAPPDATA%\anvi-data\log\anvi.log.
'scoop uninstall anvi' does not remove them; delete those folders manually.
